title: Patch: tributing a GIGA empties all four zones it covers for the play that pays it, so a GIGA Tribute card can take its place
notes: Issue #4836: freed_by_tribute (play_choices.rs) now counts the three zones a GIGA covers, as well as its anchor, as emptied by a play that tributes that GIGA (R391, R3546000), so legal_actions lists, reduce accepts and the default zone takes those zones, and the view's playReason clears with them. Engine change only, no catalog change; classify stage 2 against main's build (a83795ab15) finds Jlockeed's Evil Blueprints, A Very Dandy Lad, Zenith and Exponential Reconstructor play differently, claimed with --plays; no script changed, so no KEPT_SCRIPTS entry. A play logged before that names its zone stays legal and lands there; one that names none may now take a zone further left, and a replay this alters is refused by its final hash (R767000).

player.title: Tributing a GIGA frees every zone it stood in
fixes: Tributing a GIGA Unit frees all four zones it stood in for the card you pay with it, so a GIGA card with a Tribute cost can take its place.
A Tribute card that tributes a GIGA Unit may go into either of the GIGA's lanes, not only its left one.
